On Tue, Mar 25, 2008 at 11:09 AM, James Bullard <bul...@berkeley.edu> wrote:
>
> Forwarding to the aroma.affymetrix list.
>
> Begin forwarded message:
> > From: "Zhang, Racheal" <Rachea...@vai.org>
> > Date: March 25, 2008 11:04:29 AM PDT
> > To: 'James Bullard' <bul...@berkeley.edu>
> > Subject: RE:

> > Hi James,
> >
> > Sorry to disturb you again. I know how to read the base from CDF
> > file. However now the question is I can read the density of cel
> > file, but from density how can I know the sample's A, T, G or C for
> > each SNP_xx?

It is not completely clear to me if you are trying to retrieve the
nucleotide information for a particular allele and SNP, or if you are
trying to infer the genotype for a particular sample. If you are
looking for the former, as James say, that information is in the CDF
file, which is unrelated to samples (measured data).

If you have further questions, please let us know what kind of chip
type you are using and if you are using aroma.affymetrix or just
affxparser. It would be helpful to see an R script showing what you
are trying to do. Note, in order to reply to this message you will
need to sign up for the aroma.affymetrix mailing list. Please do so
by following the instruction at:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/subscribe

Cheers

/Henrik
